newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - President Li Teng-hui welcomes Dalai Lama to visit Taiwan.
Air force plans move, vacating choice real estate.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Two dead, one missing in torrential rain.
Agreement "in principle" reached with U.S. on medical equipment row.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance Ministry's new draft regulation tightens control on securities firms.
Commercial loan growth falls to lowest in decade.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Desposit insurance to become mandatory for all financial institutions in two years.
Differences on access to medical equipment market may prompt U.S. to impose sanctions.
